test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Indonesian police fired warning shots, tear gas and water cannon to try and ______ the crowd.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Disperse"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the blank will explain how the police fired the shots, tear gas and water cannons to scatter the crowd.**
 
• Thus, among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "disperse."
 
 
• **"Disperse" means to scatter or spread out.**(बिखेर
